Tool issue for the analyst: the quote check cannot verify a quote running from page 27 to page 28 because verify_quotes.py drop_footnotes() treats the numbered recommendation line "8.1. MF să consolideze..." in the lower half of page 27 as the start of the footnotes. The MF statement that the ICT life-cycle framework assigned to AGE "is still missing" (pages 27 to 28) is therefore not quoted; item 0144 quotes the next sentence on page 28 instead and names the missing sentence in its note.

Scope of the annexes (pages 33 to 67), for the analyst: the first pass treated all annexes as restating the body. Annex 3 also holds entity-level claims that are not in the body; two clearly in scope were added (0158 e-Votare concept, 0159 SIASA links to MConnect and MSign, both page 40). Others of the same kind were not added, for example the interconnection of the Competition Council state aid register with government e-services through Government Decision 830/2020 (page 40) and the concepts of the "Migrație" information system (Government Decision 618/2023, pages 46 to 47; a new system due by 2026, page 64). Whether Annex 3 should be extracted in full is a scope choice for the analyst.

Chapter 2 check, for the analyst: the annexes name labour-market and migration systems (SIA "EMFM" Migrația forței de muncă and the ANOFM labour-market systems, pages 65 and 66; SI "Migrație" of the General Inspectorate for Migration, pages 46, 47 and 64). They appear only in documentation, accounting and use tables, with no claim on the rights or access of EU or foreign workers, so no Chapter 2 item was added; the first pass reached the same view.
The extraction note of 0033 lists the other two corrective actions as not extracted; they are now items 0111 and 0112. The note was left unchanged.

Event date: the body says the Government approved the SIA REA concept in December 2020, but footnote 34 cites Government Decision 681 of 10 September 2020. Recorded as stated (2020-12, month); not reconciled.
